title: Injection Inside LIMIT/OFFSET on Postgres
learning_objectives: Recognise SQL injection in an integer LIMIT/OFFSET context with no string literal to break out of
Explain why a UNION SELECT cannot syntactically follow LIMIT before a statement terminator in PostgreSQL
Place a parenthesised scalar subquery in the OFFSET position as an error-based value oracle
Leak a per-instance secret through a failed text-to-integer CAST and submit it to win
flag_hint: GET /solve?code=<value> compares the submitted value to the admin user's recovery_code; on match it returns JSON containing the flag read from the flag file, otherwise HTTP 403.
inspired_by: PortSwigger 'SQL injection in a LIMIT clause' + Postgres error-oracle write-ups on scalar subqueries in OFFSET
